Traditional dishes that are rich in countryside flavor.
Apr 2024 • Friends
Recently, we made a pilgrimage to Ninh Binh to attend the Hoa Lu festival (April 18, 2024), visit Dinh and Le temples, and go to Trang An ancient town. Indeed, the scenery is charming, recreating the old town like a masterpiece. , just waiting for the culinary half to be a perfect trip, because we workers have little money and don't dare to choose luxury restaurants. When we arrived at Duc Nhat restaurant, No. 12 Hoang Hoa Tham, we found it small and pretty. , entering the elegant interior, clean and beautiful tables and chairs, warm service attitude, we order dishes according to each person's preferences and tastes, such as: bun cha, pho rolls, spring rolls... these are all delicious dishes. Traditional dishes but rich in country flavor, delicious, nutritious and affordable for workers. After eating, dessert with fruit, enjoy some directly ground coffee beans with a charming flavor. Next time we travel, we will definitely come here.
